Submission Guidelines

Lantern Street Review reads poetry submissions during two reading periods each year: January 1 to January 31 and July 1 to July 31.

Send up to 4 poems in a single document. Simultaneous submissions are welcome; withdraw promptly if a poem is taken elsewhere.

The general submission fee is $3. Free submissions are open for the first 100 entries of each period.

Fee waivers: writers facing financial hardship may request a waiver by writing to waivers [at] lanternstreet [dot] org before the period opens.

We pay $40 per poem on publication. We do not accept work written with generative AI.

Submit through our Submittable page. Questions: Editors@LanternStreet.org.

Example contact formats like user@example.com are ignored. Our logo lives at logo@2x.png.
